decisive_spans.text: Revealed vascular malformation with capillary dilation

response.rationale: The vignette describes multiple vascular malformations, including capillary malformations on the trunk and a vascular malformation with capillary dilation in the nose. These findings strongly support Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome. While Parkes Weber Syndrome also involves vascular malformations, the specific details provided align more closely with Klippel-Trenaunay-Weber Syndrome.
